scope: Current GitHub main reconciliation: legacy A/C/TLM identifiers, BAQ supplement, canonical APOL/CR catalogue, adjacent controversy packs. No prior chat-only text is assumed to exist verbatim.
method: ID presence is not text preservation. A/C ranges are represented as BAND_ONLY or NO_SOURCE until an original record is found and individually matched. Candidate canonical targets are never certified per ID. Overlapping source banks are not additive distinct questions.
publication_rules: All substantive paragraphs must cite linked original sources; source presence alone does not verify the claim.
Objections must be accurately attributed to actual proponents; debates must include real counterarguments.
Traditional commentary must state the substantive argument, not editorial/meta narration.
Keep one canonical owner for each distinct controversy and cross-link alternate surfaces.
Retain English/French parity and original question/answer provenance; no synthetic recovery.
Do not change public navigation or Mass runtime until app-ready and user-facing acceptance tests pass.

Young people only like the TLM because it is exotic and countercultural.
The TLM is elitist because ordinary people need Latin and liturgical training to follow it.
